name: Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

data_coverage.caveat: Coverage describes cached OpenAlex records, not completeness against the official proceedings.

growth_sentence: output growing about 18% a year, from 649 to 2,868 papers
glance: OpenAlex contains 16,877 papers for Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition between 2016 and 2025; output growing about 18% a year, from 649 to 2,868 papers.
The fastest-growing phrase is “diffusion models”, up from 0.0% to 3.3% of papers.
Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory gained the most share among institutions (0.0% → 2.6%); China among countries (34% → 50%).
New vocabulary: diffusion models, vision-language, text-to-image, pre-training.
